calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) distinct_lines, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days_with_sales, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cal AS (
  SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2 AND is_trading_day
),
st AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region, open_date, close_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
trading AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, COUNT(*) trading_days
  FROM st CROSS JOIN cal c
  WHERE (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= c.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= c.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure x WHERE x.store_id=st.store_id AND c.calendar_date BETWEEN x.closure_start_date AND x.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) net_sales FROM net_lines
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) ctrl_net, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) ctrl_gross, SUM(returns_net) ctrl_ret FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, t.trading_days, a.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, ROUND(a.net_sales - c.ctrl_net,2) diff, ROUND(a.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) per_day
FROM st LEFT JOIN trading t USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN agg a USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN ctrl c USING(store_id)
ORDER BY per_day DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category='ZZ Test') zz_sales_in_stores,
 (SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id=999) s999_sales,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id=129) savonlinna_returns
